title: 4021. Minimum Operations to Make a Rotated Palindrome I

examples.explanation: One optimal solution: Left rotate the string: "abc" -> "bca". Increment 'a' to 'b': "bca" -> "bcb". "bcb" is a palindrome. Thus, the answer is 2.
Increment the first character three times: "yb" -> "zb" -> "ab" -> "bb". "bb" is a palindrome. Thus, the answer is 3.

hints: It is enough to consider performing r left rotations, where 0 <= r < s.length. The increment operations can then be considered independently for each mirrored pair.
For two letters a and b, the minimum number of increments needed to make them equal is min(abs(a - b), 26 - abs(a - b)).
Try every rotation. For each one, sum this cost over all mirrored pairs and add the number of rotations. This gives an O(n^2) solution.
